column2: Which of our clients are most likely to leave us? Look at everything you can and rank the top 10 with the evidence for each.
What has our churn rate been over the last 4 years, year by year? And predict next year's churn rate.
Brightwater Logistics has left us. What pattern did they follow in the months before they churned, compared with clients that stayed? Use the whole history you have.
Which clients went quiet over the last 4 years, when did it happen, and what did they have in common before going quiet?
Give me a health table for every single client for the last 12 months: usage trend, failures, slowest tasks and warning signs.
Over the last 4 years, which dialogs and buttons have caused the most failures, and is it getting better or worse year by year?
How has usage changed per app version, quarter by quarter, over the last 4 years? Which version had the most errors?
What are the most common workflows across the last 4 years, how often do people finish them, and which clients struggle most to finish the top 3?
How long does saving a trade in Task01 take, and how has that changed month by month over the last 2 years? Which clients are slowest?
Tell me everything that changed for Harbor & Pine Capital month by month over the past 2 years, and what we should do about it.

Since the very beginning of our data, which dialog has been used the most, and which button press fails most often? Give totals.
How good have our warning signs been at predicting which clients leave? Use the full history.
